assignment.title: Xuan-Yuan Sword: Dance of the Maple Leaves

notes_text: Steam lists a historical 1995 release for a turn-based Chinese RPG set in the Warring States era, developed by DOMO Studio and SOFTSTAR. The Steam product supports Simplified and Traditional Chinese but not English; the original release date should not be mistaken for its Steam publication date.

source_log.observation: Steam product identifies the title, turn-based RPG, original release date and Chinese-only languages.
